comment: zap.c do_osshock() reached with gp.poly_zapped at its decl.c start value, 0. A level-30 debug Wizard learns polymorph, advances matter spells twice, drops everything with 5 cursed darts on top (obj_shudders() odds 3 / 2 = 1, so they always shudder), becomes a garter snake, hides with #monster and casts polymorph upward. zap_updown()'s hiding arm calls bhito() directly, not through bhitpile(), which is the only place that sets gp.poly_zapped to -1; C reads 0, skips the rn2(Luck + 45) loop and splits the stack with the next draw. The look shows how many darts survive.
